messages:
sasha: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to update the triage/playbook items and assign owners for the remediation work. I'm summarizing the action items here so we can track them. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/2026-03-20 :spiral_note_pad:

sasha: Action items:
1) Update triage steps + include exact kubectl/diagnostics commands (owner: TBD)
2) Add explicit escalation path (pages + phone numbers) to the playbook (owner: TBD)
3) Add automated smoke check for LB->backend connectivity (owner: TBD)
4) Add regression test to CI that reproduces the slow-connection pattern (owner: TBD)

alex: I can own #1 — will open a PR with the checklist and commands today. Quick snippet to include in the triage section:
```bash
# check pod health and recent restarts
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide
kubectl describe pod <pod-name> -n inference
# check node GPU usage
ssh gpu-node-01 sudo nvidia-smi
# fetch recent logs (last 2 minutes)
kubectl logs -n inference <pod-name> --since=2m
```

maria: I'll take #2. I'll add the on-call rotation phone numbers + escalation matrix and the Slack shortcut to trigger a page. Will also wire up a runbook step for immediate containment (suppress autoscale, failover to fallback model).

jamie: Noted on #3 and #4 — this matches a recurring incident pattern we've seen across 3 incidents since Dec. We should also record the sequence that precedes the outage in the playbook (spike in token rate -> KV cache overload -> model batch queue growth). I can prototype a smoke check that hits /healthz and verifies p95 latency under load.

alex: @jamie can you add the synthetic traffic test to the CI job? If it's stable we can gate the rollout of the new quantized model builds on it.

jamie: Yep — I'll add a canary job in the inference-ci pipeline and a short test that runs in ~30s. ETA: Friday EOD.

sasha: Great. Can we put due dates in this thread so the incident board can pick them up? Please reply with owner + due date. I'll create the follow-up tickets after owners confirm. :calendar:

alex: #1 — alex — due 2026-03-27 (PR ready by EOD today).

maria: #2 — maria — due 2026-03-29 (I'll add phone numbers + playbook PR).

jamie: #3,#4 — jamie — due 2026-04-02 (smoke check + CI test).

ops-bot: New follow-up ticket created: INC-FW-4873 — https://issues.redwood.internal/browse/INC-FW-4873 (linked to postmortem).

sasha: Thanks all. Next steps: owners open PRs and add the playbook/runbook edits. I'll schedule a 15m sync next Wed to verify progress and close the follow-ups. If anyone lands PRs earlier, post links here so I can attach them to the incident board. :white_check_mark:
